svg.title: Micropod iconography — light and dark
svg.desc: Twenty-four original operational pictograms, shown on warm light gray and graphite surfaces. One point seven five unit stroke on a twenty-four unit grid.

g.text: 24 original symbols · 24 × 24 grid · 1.75 stroke · round caps + joins
Use color to reinforce state. Pair unfamiliar glyphs with labels. Reserve blue for selection, links, and primary actions.
